summary: Wave 2 makes memory and retrieval dependencies: fail-closed decisions at the seven chokepoints (per surface, mode-flipped by the operator), one write path for research, deltas on the bus with fan-out from edges, ladder L1–L3, filings feed, and the identity fixes from the Wave 1 findings.

items.title: Ring 2 mode flip: DECIDE/ADVISE contexts fail closed (HOLD_MEMORY_UNAVAILABLE) at the wake engine and the advisory/options review; RESEARCH generation refused without a RetrievalReceipt at gate_and_generate — per-surface, starting with persistent-wake
items.rollback: set TRADEAI_INTELLIGENCE_MODE=SHADOW (one env line) — every hook degrades instead of refusing

items.title: writers: six producer adapters route thesis-like research through accept_research_result (external lanes, watchlist agents, analyst/research-intel, advisory opinion, options review, AEC thesis fact)
writer: façade commit publishes memory.delta on the CIO event bus (new event type) and the edge projector consumes it (fan-out from edges replaces the hard-coded thesis.changed list)
items.rule: AGENTS §17 new writer + bus event type
items.rollback: unregister the event type; consumer off

items.title: new lane: edge-fanout-consumer (bus consumer; traversal → work items)
new data source: SEC 8-K / 10-Q filings feed → EVENT nodes (Market class)
items.rule: AGENTS §7A adding a data source (operator grant recorded in the DSA row)

items.title: mint lane reads symbol theses and the ticker research graph as symbol sources (11 symbols never entered the registry); sweep re-asks Schwab for recorded misses monthly
items.rule: AGENTS §7 identity spine (deterministic; no hand-built map)
